server/runtime/envelope.ts.name: Delegated turn envelope
server/runtime/envelope.ts.description: Composes the harness-written brief, report, question and resume text a bot reads, escaping any model text that imitates it.

server/runtime/invariants.ts.name: Runtime invariants
server/runtime/invariants.ts.description: Checks stored assignments and events for orphaned, double-reported, duplicate or unreplayable rows.

server/runtime/handoff-limits.ts.name: Total turn limits
server/runtime/handoff-limits.ts.description: Sets the 300-turn and 5-failures-in-a-row caps per request tree, overridable by two environment variables.

server/runtime/status-reply.ts.name: Acknowledgement filter
server/runtime/status-reply.ts.description: Lets a small model decide whether a teammate's reply is a bare acknowledgement so the requester is not woken.

server/runtime/capabilities.ts.name: Engine capability table
server/runtime/capabilities.ts.description: Lists per-engine flags for native resume, auto review, edits and full access that the level rule reads.

server/drivers/agents-thread-post-tool.t.name: Thread post tool
server/drivers/agents-thread-post-tool.t.description: Posts one message into an existing thread, optionally waking a run there, with a delivery id for dedupe.

server/drivers/agents-devs-tools.ts.name: Bug report tool
server/drivers/agents-devs-tools.ts.description: Sends a person's bug report from a bot to the developer team through an internal route.

server/peer-provenance.ts.name: Peer provenance notes
server/peer-provenance.ts.description: Builds the notes that label relayed bot text, quotes the person's request and escapes imitations of harness notes.

server/provenance-label.ts.name: Provenance label format
server/provenance-label.ts.description: Formats the From who, what and authority note and defines the three authority values every non-owner line carries.

server/peer-roster.ts.name: Peer roster and reach
server/peer-roster.ts.description: Decides which bots can reach and manage each other, resolves teammate names and ids and renders the roster prompt.

server/chief-of-staff.ts.name: Chief of Staff prompt
server/chief-of-staff.ts.description: Builds the lead agent's system prompt: delegation rules, specialist creation, incident handling and team roster.

server/chief-level.ts.name: Chief powers check
server/chief-level.ts.description: Decides whether a bot holds Chief powers and which role tools its tool list shows.

server/room-post-budget.ts.name: Room post breaker
server/room-post-budget.ts.description: Refuses duplicate, ring, over-rate and unanswered bot room posts and closes the room for five minutes on a loop.

server/same-name-mentions.ts.name: Same-name mention check
server/same-name-mentions.ts.description: Refuses a line or bot post that @-tags a name several room members share unless one was picked.

server/room-routing-members.ts.name: Routable room members
server/room-routing-members.ts.description: Filters room members into available, goal and routable sets and picks the default responder when routing is auto.

server/room-steer-addressee.ts.name: Room steer addressing
server/room-steer-addressee.ts.description: Decides whether a queued room line is meant for the speaking bot, using mentions and the room lead.

server/room-context.ts.name: Room context tracker
server/room-context.ts.description: Tracks each member's context size in a room and decides when to compact it at a threshold of the window.

server/decider/room-routing.ts.name: Room responder decider
server/decider/room-routing.ts.description: Asks a small model which member should answer a room message, falling back below 0.6 confidence or on failure.

shared/room-mentions.ts.name: Mention resolver
shared/room-mentions.ts.description: Resolves @names in a line to bots, treating shared names as ambiguous unless picked from the @ list.

server/host/starter-caps.ts.name: Starter plan caps
server/host/starter-caps.ts.description: Refuses hand-offs to paused bots or beyond the plan's running and waiting task slots, with retry-free wording.

server/host/usage-cap-gate.ts.name: Usage cap gate
server/host/usage-cap-gate.ts.description: Checks spend and token caps before turns and hand-offs and tells the handing bot why work was refused.

server/host/handoff-status.ts.name: Hand-off status lines
server/host/handoff-status.ts.description: Projects assignment rows into the Sent to status line without exposing the work's words or private chat titles.

server/host/handed-line.ts.name: Handed-work chat line
server/host/handed-line.ts.description: Keeps one quiet activity line in a bot's main chat for work a teammate handed it, folded and bounded.

server/host/delegated-level.ts.name: Delegated level passing
server/host/delegated-level.ts.description: Applies a Chief conversation's approval level down each hand-off hop, in threads and rooms alike.

server/host/question-routing.ts.name: Question routing
server/host/question-routing.ts.description: Routes a bot's or Chief's message into a parked question or running turn as an addition with the right authority.

server/section-context.ts.name: Department context
server/section-context.ts.description: Stores department-wide context text that agents cannot write, keyed by stable section memory keys.

server/host/handoff-requests.ts.name: Sign-in handoff cards
server/host/handoff-requests.ts.description: Creates the sign-in or handoff card a bot asks the person to act on, with expiry and supersession.

src/components/HandoffStatusChip.tsx.name: Hand-off status chip
src/components/HandoffStatusChip.tsx.description: Renders a hand-off's state as a small chip on the Sent to row and the working conversation.

src/components/SidebarBotActivity.tsx.name: Sidebar bot activity
src/components/SidebarBotActivity.tsx.description: Lists each bot's threads in the sidebar with busy, waiting and unread state and hand-off status text.

shared/handoff-status.ts.name: Hand-off status types
shared/handoff-status.ts.description: Re-exports the phone protocol's hand-off status types shared by server and clients.
